henry.title: Mission Log: Write Like an Engineer
henry.intro: Real engineers write clear logs. Write a mission log for a rocket launch from Spaceport America, NM!
worksheet: Write a title for your mission.
Write 5 sentences: goal, launch, problem, fix, result.
Find a compound word you used.
links: Find a real NASA mission story to get ideas for your log.

frankie.title: Super Letters: S is for Super!
frankie.intro: Super Why says: letters have super powers! Let's find S.
worksheet: Trace: S S S s s s
Draw something that starts with S (sun? snake?)
Circle the S word: sun / cat
links: Tap a game with a grown-up and find the letter S.
